escenas.texto: Which was the most liked video in Oceania this week? Here is the podium. Watch until the end.
In third place, She's deep in shark territory 😳, by BondiRescue, with over 183 thousand likes.
In second place, Rate our DANCE? 🕺 @SofiManassyan, by NickandCarrie, with over 227 thousand likes.
And number one: How you invented blinds!, by Odd Tilt, with over 438 thousand likes.
The full countdown, from ten to one, is already on the channel. Find it in the description. Hashtag Top 10 RS.
